name: /drill
description: Deep-dive into a specific topic from memory. Usage: /drill <topic>
argument_description: The topic, feature, or theme to drill into (e.g., 'emotional grading', 'supabase migration', 'accountability system')

steps.description: Search ALL events for topic-relevant content, then do 2-pass AI reconstruction for deep detail

outputs.detailed_memory: Full detailed reconstruction of the topic across all time periods

steps.action: Display the detailed memory reconstruction to user
steps.context: This is a deep-dive into a specific topic. Show the output verbatim — it's already formatted. If the user wants to act on anything surfaced, offer to help.
